intent: A dark, monochrome note where @people and #channels become single tokens, and the suggestion list follows the caret rather than sitting under the field.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colour tokens as CSS variables on the root; color-mix() for person tokens, the active avatar ring and the selection
stack.animation: motion/react: entrance blur, the list’s arrival, layoutId for the suggestion highlight. Inserted tokens use the Web Animations API so the contenteditable DOM can move without a React re-render
stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist) for the UI and the note, font-display (Geist) for the heading, font-mono (Geist Mono) for labels, channel tokens and the hint. font-serif is the optional document voice

layout.card: surface, 1px line, 14px radius, inset highlight + deep shadow, no overflow hidden, @container root, 560px max in the demo
layout.header: 18px display title and a mono 11px uppercase workspace
layout.well: sunken, 12px radius, inset 20px (24px from @md). Contenteditable, min-height 9.5rem, muted body, ink tokens
layout.tokens: person: accent 16% fill, 28% inset, first name. channel: raised, mono, 1px line, #name. Both nowrap, 5px radius
layout.list: absolute at the caret, 8px below, or above when it would leave the viewport. Width min(272, well-16), left clamped inside the well. Mono label, then 44px rows: 28px avatar, 13px name, 11px mono meta
layout.footer: hairline and a mono 11px hint that changes while the list is open

typography.title: display 18px semibold, tracking -0.03em
typography.note: 15px sans, leading 1.65, muted; or 17px serif, leading 1.55
typography.token: inherits the note, medium, ink; channels are mono at 0.92em
typography.list: name 13px medium ink; meta mono 11px faint; label mono 10px uppercase tracking 0.12em

color.approach: greyscale; one accent on person tokens, the active person avatar and the text selection. Channels stay neutral
color.accent: #f5a524 by default. Person fill 16%, inset 28%, active ring 55%, selection 35%

motion.order: card, header, well, hint: 12px rise, 8px blur, 0.5s, 60ms apart
motion.list: 6px offset and 4px blur over 0.2s; exit 120ms ease-in; highlight on spring 500/40; row press 0.98
motion.token: inserted tokens rise 2px out of a 4px blur in 280ms. The initial paint does not
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only. Follow mounted changes; cancel current entrance and native token animations, settle suggestions, and preserve the editor and caret.

responsive.320: the well stays inset, the list clamps to the well width, rows stay 44px and names truncate
responsive.390: the seeded sentence wraps to two or three lines inside the 9.5rem well; the list still opens at the caret
responsive.768+: the well’s side inset grows from 20px to 24px; the note keeps a comfortable measure inside the 560px card

accessibility: textbox is multiline, named by the title, with aria-autocomplete, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant
suggestions are options in a listbox labelled People or Channels
tokens expose Mention or Channel in their accessible name; avatars are aria-hidden
a polite live region announces the inserted person or channel; the hint is polite too

content.product: Ledgerline’s website, a Friday note on the v3 headline
content.people: Mara Ilić, Jonas Weber, Priya Raman, Sam Okoye, Pablo Ferreira
content.seed: @mara, the v3 headline is ready for a last look in #legal before Friday.
content.demo: clicks the empty end of the note, types @pr, Enter inserts @Priya, then types “ can sign off”

avoid: a comment thread with authors, replies and resolve
a suggestion list pinned to the top or bottom of the field
accent on channel tokens, or a different hue per person
tokens that wrap or that take two backspaces to delete
repainting the contenteditable on every keystroke
